raw_cosine_note: Not informative, kept for the record: raw_cos_with_A0, raw_cos_with_A0_layer_mean and summary.raw are cos(v_arm, v_A0) without centring.  Every role vector shares a large common component, so raw cosines between role vectors are all above 0.9999 (Roger, 2026-10-22: 'Raw embedding cosine is meaningless').  The comparison is centred.<reference>, cos(v_arm - r, v_A0 - r).

default.definition: the default entity's step-4 vector (the mean of all its activations), from --default-vector; one fixed reference for every arm

median.definition: the elementwise median, per slot and layer, of the A0 vectors of the roles analysed (for an even count the mean of the two middle values; NaN entries left out); one fixed reference for every arm
